svg.title: Focus Cost Control Azure architecture
svg.desc: An Azure deployment shape with a public web Container App, Entra authentication, internal API, private PostgreSQL subnet, Blob Storage, Service Bus, worker and migration jobs, Key Vault, managed identities and Application Insights.
svg.text: Public web edge · private API/data plane · managed identity · migration-before-smoke
Azure Container Apps environment · public web ingress · VNet-integrated private services

g.text: Web is the only public ingress; API validates issuer, audience, and operator group.
PostgreSQL has no public network access; Blob and Bus use managed identity RBAC.

svg.text: Azure product icons: Microsoft Azure Architecture Icons V24 · https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/icons/ · icons are preserved unchanged.
